description: This file defines the CalendarAccountRepository class, which provides methods for querying, validating, and managing calendar account records within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for retrieving accounts based on various filters, checking for specific account types, and finding accounts by external IDs.

classes.name: CalendarAccountRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing data access methods for calendar account entities within SuiteCRM, including retrieval, filtering, and existence checks for calendar accounts.

methods.name: getValidatedAccountsBatch
methods.description: Retrieves all validated calendar accounts in a single optimized query, with optional limit.

methods.name: hasPersonalCalendarAccount
methods.description: Checks whether a specific user has a personal calendar account.

methods.name: getPersonalCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves all personal calendar accounts for a user.

methods.name: getValidatedPersonalCalendarAccountForUser
methods.description: Gets the most recent validated personal calendar account for a user.

methods.name: getAllValidatedCalendarAccountsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all validated calendar accounts for a user.

methods.name: findByExternalCalendarId
methods.description: Finds a calendar account by external calendar ID, excluding a specific account ID if provided.

methods.name: getCalendarAccountsForUser
methods.description: Core method to retrieve calendar accounts with flexible filtering options.
